info.title: Quant Trading API
info.description: Full quantitative trading platform API — auth, market data, strategies, backtests, orders, positions, risk, AI predictions.

get.description:
Admin list: every flag row (raw, no per-user evaluation). The admin
UI reads this to populate the toggle table.

post.description:
Admin upsert: create or update a flag row by `key`. The response is
the persisted row. The cache is invalidated automatically by
`svc::upsert`.

delete.description:
Admin delete. Returns 204 if a row was actually removed, 404
otherwise. The cache is invalidated automatically.

404.description: Flag with that key not found

get.description:
List audit log entries. All filters are optional and combine as AND.
Pagination: `page` (1-indexed, default 1) / `size` (default 20, max 200).

Response shape: `ApiResponse<AuditLogPage>` where `AuditLogPage = { items, total, page, size }`.
Single audit entry by primary key. Returns 404 if not found.

User bootstrap: returns the per-user evaluation of every known flag.
Frontend caches this map and uses it via `useFeatureFlag(key)`. We
evaluate against the *current* caller's `user_id` so the response
naturally captures whitelist + percentage rollout.

200.description: Per-user boolean evaluation of every known flag

get.summary: Readiness probe: DB 与 Redis 都可达时返回 200，否则 503。
get.description:
任何一个依赖 ping 失败就把整体标记为 unready。响应体里逐项列出结果，
方便 dashboard / pagerDuty 看到具体哪个依赖挂了。

403.description: Role not permitted for the requested depth

get.summary: GET /api/v1/market/ticker — 获取单个交易对 Ticker
GET /api/v1/market/tickers — 获取所有交易对 Ticker

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/pamm/funds` — open a new fund. The caller becomes
its manager.

`POST /api/v1/pamm/funds/{id}/distribute` — manager triggers a
profit distribution for the given period.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/pamm/funds/{id}/investments` — manager + self can
see the investor list.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/pamm/funds/{id}/liquidate` — manager liquidates the
fund. Returns 204 No Content on success.

400.description: Validation failed (e.g. old password wrong, new password too short)

get.summary: Liveness probe: 进程在跑就返回 200。
get.description:
不检查任何外部依赖。即使下游 DB/Redis 全挂，liveness 仍应返回 OK，
否则 k8s 会重启 Pod，而重启并不能恢复下游。

management_fee_pct.description:
Annualised management fee as a fraction (0.02 = 2%). Stored as
string to preserve precision (JSON Decimal round-trip).

performance_fee_pct.description: Performance fee as a fraction of HWM-increment profit (0.20 = 20%).

DistributionView.description: Per-period distribution row exposed in the manager dashboard.

FeatureFlag.description:
Wire shape for a feature flag row. The `db::feature_flag::Model` is
the SeaORM-internal representation and uses a `Json` value for
`user_whitelist` / `metadata`; this DTO is what the admin UI sees and
what `openapi-typescript` consumes. All fields are camelCase on the
wire (`#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]`).

description.description: Free-text description shown in the admin UI.

enabled.description:
Global on/off switch. When `false`, no other column matters (other
than whitelist overrides — see `services::feature_flag::evaluate_flag`).

key.description: Primary key, e.g. `"iceberg_order"`. VARCHAR(64) on the DB side.

percentageRollout.description: 0..=100 — share of users (excluding whitelist) that see the feature.

updatedBy.description: Admin user id (UUID) who last edited the row, if known.

userWhitelist.description:
JSON array of user UUIDs that always see the feature as on,
regardless of `enabled` or `percentage_rollout`. Stored as JSONB.

FeatureFlagEvaluation.description:
Response shape for the user bootstrap endpoint: a flat
`{flag_key: bool}` map. The frontend renders UI affordances based on
this map; unknown keys are absent (i.e. missing → treat as off).

flags.description:
The `key` (string) of the flag. utoipa's `ToSchema` derive on a
`HashMap<String, bool>` produces an open object with `additionalProperties:
{ type: boolean }`, which is exactly what the SPA expects.

FundView.description:
Subset of `pamm_funds` row surfaced via the API. Decimals are
serialised as strings to preserve precision.

InvestmentView.description: Per-user view of their investment, enriched with current value.

UpsertFeatureFlagRequest.description:
Request body for the admin upsert. Mirrors `entity::Model` but takes
only the editable fields — the server fills in timestamps, and
`updated_by` from the caller.

description.description: Free-text description shown in the admin UI.

enabled.description:
Global on/off switch. When `false`, no other column matters (other
than whitelist overrides — see `services::feature_flag::evaluate_flag`).

key.description:
Primary key, e.g. `"iceberg_order"`. VARCHAR(64) on the DB side;
the handler validates length before forwarding.

metadata.description:
Free-form JSON, e.g. `{"experiment": "v2"}`. Defaults to `{}`
when the admin doesn't supply one.

percentage_rollout.description:
0..=100 — share of users (excluding whitelist) that see the
feature. Server-side clamped on read; we also clamp on write to
keep the DB clean.

user_whitelist.description:
JSON array of user UUIDs that always see the feature as on,
regardless of `enabled` or `percentage_rollout`. Stored as JSONB.
